run_distributed_embeddingbag_validation: run the distributed EmbeddingBag validation script with torchrun on 2 GPUs to verify correctness
test_no_mp_embeddingbag: test the EmbeddingBag forward and backward pass without model parallelism as a baseline
test_mp_embeddingbag: test the EmbeddingBag with model parallelism and FSDP sharding at a given mp_size
create_embeddingbag_test_data: create an xFormerEmbeddingBag with random indices, per-sample weights, and a gradient tensor for testing
review_distributed_parallelization: review the ColwiseEmbeddingBag parallelization and fully_shard FSDP configuration for distributed training
